topic: Most abundant elements in the human body by mass
title: Elements in the human body
subtitle: Share of body mass in %
hook: What are YOU made of? Can you guess #1?
fact: By atom count, ~60% of your body is hydrogen, yet it's only ~10% of your mass.

captions.instagram:
You're mostly oxygen! 🧬 Just four elements make up about 96% of your body mass. Which one did you expect to be #1? Tell us in the comments! 👇
Source: NIH (NIGMS), Britannica
